dedupe_keys.name: model predictive control for buildings test environment with comfort energy cost and flexibility market

description: This software is a test environment for model predictive control (MPC) of buildings: it simulates a full year and periodically decides the best control action path. It was published on Zenodo by Roberto Garay Martinez; version 4.0 is dated 20 August 2026. The optimal path balances comfort during occupied periods, the cost of energy and, optionally, commitments in a flexibility market, with decisions structured and synchronised with market processes. The README documents the building model, control modes and setpoints, policy, market structure, marginal cost evaluation, a genetic algorithm optimiser, optimisation and control horizons, flexibility events, a graphical parametrisation interface, input and output files and known issues. Coverage: generic buildings configured by the user. Access: a code archive of about 1 MB and README on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 per Zenodo; free. Caveats: written in R (Main.R and helper scripts, with CSV parameter files, per the Zenodo archive listing); no public issue tracker was found. Simulation uses: testing demand flexibility and predictive control strategies for buildings. Related records: the grid-interactive efficient building technology data and the grey-brick RC models.
